text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The committee established to look into the way money from Zimbabwe's War Victims Compensation Fund was disbursed is expected to complete its findings by the end of this week, public service, labour and social welfare minister Florence Chitauro said.

- The Zimbabwe government plans to establish a tourism revolving fund to provide loans to local black entrepreneurs seeking to participate in the industry, which is currently dominated by whites and foreign companies.
- A male nurse in northern Zimbabwe last Wednesday performed a "Caesarean operation" on a woman in labour, severing the unborn child's hands in the process after assuming it was already dead.
